ink.use: Logo bodies, body text, primary buttons, dark surfaces

paper.use: Logo screens, page background, text on dark

signal.use: Logo cable and plugs, accents, underlines, focus rings, fills behind Ink text. Never as text on light (1.5:1)

surface.use: Cards and raised panels on Paper

signal-text.use: Gold text on Paper when Signal is wanted as text (4.6:1, AA)

port-blue.use: Optional link/UI blue; not in the logo

port-blue-text.use: Port Blue as text on Paper (5.0:1)

display.use: 800: wordmark and headings · 500: uppercase slogans and labels

logo.wordmark: DIGIMEISTER in Rubik 800, uppercase, tracking 0.03em (0.05em below 48 px tall)
logo.clearSpace: 52 mark units = 10.4% of the mark's width / 20.8% of its height, on all sides
